instruction: A cinematic film still of a medium shot capturing a couple on an outdoor hilltop overlook at sunset. On the left, the woman in the floral strap top (R2) stands in profile facing right, smiling gently with her hand raised to her hair. On the right, the man in the black beanie and black t-shirt (R1) stands in profile facing left, smiling warmly at her. They stand close together, sharing an intimate moment against a soft, blurred city skyline. The scene is illuminated by warm, backlit golden hour light, creating a bright, hazy background and a soft glow around their silhouettes.
elements: R2 raises a hand to her hair while facing R1
R1 smiles warmly at R2 while facing her
R1 and R2 stand close together in profile facing each other
R2 smiles gently during the face-to-face moment
outdoor hilltop overlook at sunset with a blurred city skyline
